current_summary: LargeTitle 'Lists' → Input 'Add to your list…' (≥2 chars: catalog suggestion rows + Add '{term}') → TO BUY (category-ordered, no aisle headers) → IN YOUR CART (header ⋯ = Clear without restocking; footer 'Restock N to Kitchen') → SUGGESTED (out/low pantry rows, 8 + Show all) → recategorise sheet (12 chips + Cancel). Costs: typed add = focus + keystrokes + return; suggestion = 1 tap; tick = 1; remove = swipe + 1 (Undo toast); category = swipe + 2; restock = 1 + review; clear = 3. The keyboard is the primary add path; Suggested is the only control-first path and sits below the list.

current_summary: RecipeForm: Title (autofocus) → Photo (200pt dashed box; Alert chooser) → Servings (number pad) → Time (two number pads + Clear) → Difficulty slider → Tags (chips + 'Choose tags…' + free text) → Description (single line) → Ingredients (rows: name Input · trash · '→ linked name' · amount Input · Optional chip · ▲▼) + 'Add ingredient…' type-ahead → Steps (numbered Inputs + '+ Add step') → Visibility (3 radio cards) → 'Create recipe' → Delete. ≈45–50 actions for a modest recipe; keyboard on servings/time/tags/description. Import: header → RECIPE LINK Input → 'Import' → expectation copy (photo arm: two buttons) → the same form prefilled ('From smittenkitchen.com', Public disabled). Ideas: BottomSheet from Cook → cards (title · summary · chips · See method · 'Save as draft') → Regenerate → 'Saved to My recipes' toast, then 2 more taps to reach the draft.
